close_reason: Adopted extras policy across 3 types in jmap-sharing-types (ChangedBy, ShareNotification, Principal). cargo test --workspace --all-features: 1725 (+3). Commit ad9b492.
description:
Apply the workspace extras-preservation policy (JMAP-lbdy) to crate-jmap-sharing-types.

In scope (estimate ~3 public wire-shaped Deserialize structs):
- Principal
- ShareNotification

Out of scope:
- Filter / Comparator algebra (PrincipalFilterCondition, ShareNotificationFilterCondition).
- Property selector enums.

NOTE: Principal already has Sloppy-Value fields capabilities and accounts (HashMap<*, Value>) for cross-spec-owned schemas. Those are fine as-is — they are intentional, documented in PLAN.md. The `extra` field is for fields not yet in any registered capability, distinct from those intentional-Value fields.

Acceptance: every in-scope struct has `pub extra: Map<String, Value>` with the documented attributes; one round-trip preservation test per type; PLAN.md updated; cargo test/clippy/fmt clean.
title: Adopt extras policy in jmap-sharing-types
